Value.description: A raw value: true/false; an integer (an int, a fixed's underlying integer, a float's bit pattern), as a decimal string outside ±2^53; a variant name; a table's or list's elements; or a record's fields.

field.description:
The field the tick ended in, counted from the recording's start.
Two ticks in one field, or a field with none, is the original
falling behind.

pad.description:
The buttons held during that field, when they differ from the
previous tick's (none are held at the initial moment).

tick.description: Ticks since the initial moment: 1, 2, ... with no gaps.

values.description: The quantities that changed, with their values at the tick's end.

title: each later line of a scenarios/<id>/<name>.jsonl
